film.title: Clown
film.tagline: A painted smile can hide a lot of teeth.
film.logline: A performer trapped behind a grotesque clown persona begins to lose control as the mask, the audience, and the joke turn against him.
film.synopsis: Clown is a horror short about performance, humiliation, and the terror of being watched. Set inside a tense, nightmarish world of greasepaint, stage lights, and forced laughter, the film explores what happens when a character built to entertain becomes something deeply unsafe.

poster.alt: Poster for the horror short film Clown

stills.alt: A dark atmospheric moment from Clown

film.directorStatement: Clown uses the image of the entertainer as a source of dread. I wanted to explore the moment when something designed to make people laugh becomes intimate, unstable, and frightening.

seo.metaDescription: Clown is a horror short film about performance, identity, and the terror hiding beneath a painted smile.
